author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Juicy chicken skewers, warm homemade lavash, and a bold chili sauce come together in this rustic village-style meal 🔥🌶️ In this video, we prepare everything from scratch using simple ingredients and traditional outdoor cooking.

The chicken is grilled over hot coals until beautifully browned and smoky, while the fresh lavash is baked until soft and lightly crisp. A homemade chili sauce adds a spicy, flavorful finish that brings the whole meal together.

This is simple countryside cooking full of fire, freshness, and bold flavor. Tender chicken, freshly baked lavash, and homemade chili sauce make a hearty meal that’s perfect for enjoying outdoors with family. 🍗🌿🔥
title: Village Style Chicken Skewers with Lavash & Chili Sauce 🔥🌶️
